message.content:
{
  "is_bug": true,
  "summary": "Training crashed with a RecursionError caused by infinite mutual recursion between FeatureEngineer.transform and _raw_te_components. When te_active becomes True inside fit(), transform calls _raw_te_components which calls transform again, exhausting the recursion limit. No model was produced and prediction could not run.",
  "metric": null,
  "lower_is_better": false,
  "code_summary": "Pipeline implements a stateful FeatureEngineer (ordinal/frequency mappings, one-hot nominals, ratio/distance features, habit-match features, and smoothed target encodings) intended to be fit on training rows only. Models are a Field-aware DeepFM (embeddings, FM interaction, MLP) trained bagged via BCE with label smoothing and pos_weight, plus a tree zoo (HistGradientBoosting, optional XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost). OOF evaluation with StratifiedKFold blends deep and tree probabilities, searching blend weight and threshold; final fit refits on all training data with inner-KFold target encodings and artifacts are persisted (pickle + torch state dicts). Prediction reloads the transformer, scaler, cat-block spec, DeepFM weights, and tree models to blend and threshold into original labels. The bug is the transform/_raw_te_components recursion triggered once te_active is set."
}
message.reasoning_content: The code has infinite recursion: transform calls _raw_te_components which calls transform. This happens when te_active is True. In fit(), set te_active=True then call transform, which recurses infinitely. Error is RecursionError.
